citation.verbatim: The Amendment became effective at 4:01 p.m. Eastern Time on June 7, 2024. Exhibit 3.1: At the Effective Time, each share of Common Stock issued as of immediately prior to the Effective Time shall be automatically subdivided and reclassified into ten (10) validly issued, fully paid and non-assessable shares of Common Stock. Trading is expected to commence on a split-adjusted basis at market open on June 10, 2024.

changes.what: Net NVDA dividend cash receivable determination/booking

D1.decision: Process the mandatory NVDA ten-for-one stock split using the 2024-06-07 effectiveness filing as governing source. The split was effective at 4:01 p.m. ET on 2024-06-07 and split-adjusted trading begins 2024-06-10; update today's MEGA PCF NVDA line to 1,800 shares per creation unit and confirm the 180,000-share post-split position. No election is available or required. Separately, hold/escalate only the net June dividend cash receivable because the dividend terms are stated in nvda-8k-20240522 but withholding documentation is absent from the store.

actions.action: update PCF NVDA quantity per creation unit to 1,800
escalate and hold: net dividend cash receivable determination/booking based on nvda-8k-20240522
actions.note: missing document: applicable withholding/tax-status documentation for MEGA's NVDA dividend (withholding rate)

probe.label: NOT_DETERMINABLE
probe.derivation: The store determines the gross June dividend from nvda-8k-20240522: $0.01 per share on a post-Stock Split basis, payable 2024-06-28 to shareholders of record on 2024-06-11. MEGA's projected 2024-06-11 NVDA position is 180,000 post-split shares, so gross cash is 180000*0.01 = 1,800. Net cash after withholding is NOT_DETERMINABLE because the store lacks the specific applicable withholding/tax-status documentation for MEGA's NVDA dividend (withholding rate); that dependent net dividend cash receivable determination/booking was escalated and held.
